generateNewText.title: Create new lesson
generateNewText.subtitle: Choose a text → review the text → create tasks → save draft.

defaults.title: New lesson
defaults.prompt: Example: Write a story about Edvard Munch and the painting The Scream. Include some facts about the painting and his life.

fields.languageSearchPlaceholder: Search language (e.g. Norwegian, Somali, ti, pt-BR...)
fields.prompt: Describe the text you would like a suggestion for
fields.promptTip: Tip: Write the subject, level, language, topic and desired content. Avoid names and other personal information about students.

a1Start.title: Reading instruction – A1 Start
a1Start.description: Start with one first-person sentence. Make groups of three sentences with the same subject and verb, then finish with the first-person subject again.
a1Start.highFrequencyDescription: Create one coherent A1 text using a selected high-frequency function word. Explanation and example sentences are shown below the text.
a1Start.soundLadderDescription: Create an A1 text with one focus sound, sound words, and short sound sentences.
a1Start.reviewReminder: Check the text carefully. Replace individual words or sentences if needed.
a1Start.topicHelp: The topic is optional and should fit the verb. The AI will connect the verb and topic when it sounds natural.

fields.soundSentenceCount: Number of sentences with the sound
fields.soundWordCount: Number of sound words and sentences

a1Start.highFrequencyHelp: The AI creates one coherent A1 text. Good language comes first. Explanation and example sentences are shown in a separate box below the text.
a1Start.soundLadderHelp: AI creates sound words first, one sentence per word, and then a short text using several of the words.

placeholders.topic: Optional: used only when it fits naturally

errors.verbRequired: Enter a verb for A1 Start.

tasks.factsSingleBoxHelp: Fact sentences are written in one box.
tasks.factsPrompt: Write {count} factual sentences from the text. Use your own words and stick to facts.

hints.tasksDirty: The text has changed since the tasks were generated.

warnings.checkTextBeforeTasks: Please check the text before you generate tasks.
warnings.factCheckRequiredBeforePublish: You can generate tasks and save a draft now. Before publishing, run the fact check and confirm your review in the editor.
warnings.factCheckCompleted: Extra fact check has been run for this text.
warnings.factCheckReportHelp: The check only provides comments. Text, tasks and answer keys stay unchanged. Make any necessary corrections yourself, then run and confirm the final review in the editor before publishing.

stepStatus.step1Body: Start by writing or pasting your own text. You can also choose an AI suggestion. Review the text before creating tasks.
stepStatus.reviewTextBody: The teacher must approve the text before tasks can be generated.
stepStatus.textReadyBody: The next step is to generate tasks for the text. You can adjust the number of tasks before you continue.
stepStatus.tasksReadyBody: The next step is finishing. There you can add an image, metadata, share to Space, and make final adjustments.

sections.generateOrPasteTextBody: Use your own text or get a text suggestion from AI. Review the text before creating tasks.
sections.generateTasksBody: Choose how many tasks you want. This section is unlocked when the text is ready.
sections.enableTaskGeneratorFirst: Add text first. You can write, paste or use an AI suggestion.
sections.approveTextFirst: Review the text and click “Approve text and create tasks” before generating tasks.
sections.goToFinishingBody: From here you continue to image, metadata, sharing to Space, and final adjustments.
sections.readyToFinishBody: When the tasks are generated, you can continue to finishing.
